hypothesis: For 4 heldout digit-image corruption tasks from one frozen base, a tiny structured Mirror task code fitted from each task's labeled support may preserve native independent rank-4 LoRA classification accuracy/NLL with less inference-bank storage and no more than 10% P95 overhead relative to a *same-byte ordinary source-trained linear code*. This is a stringent incremental-Mirror test and not reproduction of native LoGo algorithm.
study_class: natural sklearn digits classification task shifts + trained independent LoRA source family; tiny CPU trained models, not published LoGo/LLM
object: Frozen source-pretrained MLP 64->64 GELU->10 with no task ID, same weights across all tasks. Adapt final linear projection with LoRA rank4 / other code.

geometry.U: Shared source delta left singular subspace 64x4
geometry.V: Shared source delta right singular subspace 4x10
geometry.mirror: Delta_j=U @ [Q(m_j) C Q(m_j)^T] @ V, Q product of Givens pairs [(0,1),(2,3),(0,2),(1,3)]
geometry.linear4: Delta_j=U @ [sum_{a=1}^4 c_j[a] C_source[a]] @ V; source cores from top rank4 SVD of independently trained source task core matrices, same learned task code count
geometry.fullcore16: Delta_j=U @ C_j @ V, full 16 coeff/task (strong upper-capacity shared basis control)
geometry.native_lora4: Delta_j=A_j @ B_j, A_j 64x4, B_j 4x10, same support optimization budget; no source basis calibration used
geometry.physical_byte_contract: Actual named np.savez byte lengths including frozen base weights, U/V/C/orbit or plain 4-core dictionary and all 4 task codes, plus JSON metadata. Exclude source training optimizer state from inference size but report source training steps and 6 source LoRA support calls separately.

data.dataset: scikit-learn load_digits 1797 grayscale 8x8 with fixed original digit classes; no external download
data.full_original_split: one train/test stratified random split of original image IDs per seed: 75% train/25% audit, never use audit labels for base or source/support.
data.base_training: Unshifted training originals, Gaussian minibatches; preprocessing mean/std from base train only.
data.split_policy: exact same original train/test IDs per method, different independent per-role corruptions, same source role labels. Fresh worlds are repeated dataset partitions, NOT independent new natural task datasets.
data.support_original_examples: up to 300 training originals per target role, stratified by label; source training gets full train originals; audit uses only heldout test originals.
data.preprocessing: raw image pixels scale /16. Source & target task transforms applied before standardization; normalize with original TRAIN-only pixel mean/std+0.15 stabilizer. No test adaptation.

source_lora.seeded_parameters: A random small, B zero, fixed base

optimization.preselection: No hyperparameter sweep; fixed globally before development/fresh. No fresh tuning.
optimization.learning_precision: FP32 trained, FP64 source SVD and numeric verification

evaluation.per_role: Fresh test cross-entropy nat/example, top1 accuracy, worst target role, paired NLL difference vs native source linear-bank and independent native LoRA4
evaluation.router: None. Data role explicitly supplied; native LoGo input-conditioned selection/merge NOT implemented. This is stored adapter-bank compression only.
evaluation.comparison: At full inference bank bytes: Mirror vs native independent LoRA, same-code ordinary linear4 and diag4; fullcore16 as quality reference.
evaluation.compute: Batch128 four outputs one shared base, dense group GEMM/tiny tensor ops, CPU 1 thread, 20 warmups/100 repeats P50/P95, record torch version.
evaluation.small_seed_n: 5 fresh are correlated dataset splits, use descriptive mean/min/max and n=5 paired, not 95% intervals.

gates.PASS_MIRROR_SPECIFIC: For >=4/5 fresh worlds: mirror bank mean NLL<=native LoRA mean NLL +0.02 nat/example, mirror total bank serialized bytes<=0.85 native LoRA bank, Mirror mean NLL <= same-byte ordinary linear4 mean NLL-0.01, Mirror P95<=1.10x same-byte native linear4. Entirely separate >10 task-world study needed for ADOPTED.
gates.FAIL: Mirror fails native LoRA quality, is dominated by same-byte simple linear/diag or fullcore, or latency exceeds 10% relative to simple code; source-only low-rank basis is insufficient for off-orbit shift functions.
gates.UNCERTAIN: No independently trained *natural* model family beyond shifted digits, fresh overlaps in underlying images, runtime not CUDA, strong native LoGo not reproduced; so full MA-1178 remains UNTESTED even if conditional mechanism passes.

source and target role transform properties change inputs
